stage0080_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Let go of me, $$甲児$$!
　I can't forgive my father!」

stage0080_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$タケル$$
「Commander Ikari used the Dummy System
　to save you!」

stage0080_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But then what about $$アスカ$$...!」

stage0080_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$甲児$$
「Even so, taking it out on your dad...!」

stage0080_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Shut up!
　Let go of me!!」

stage0080_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$タケル$$
「But if we leave things as they are...」

stage0080_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$甲児$$
「That's right!
　You two were finally getting closer!」

stage0080_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$竜馬$$
「It ain't about reason.
　Let $$シンジ$$ do what he wants.」

stage0080_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If that's all it takes to break them
　as father and son, so be it.」

stage0080_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$赤木$$
「I agree with $$竜馬$$ on this.
　If $$シンジ$$ won't go, I'll go protest
　this to Commander Ikari myself.」

stage0080_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$碇ゲンドウ$$...
　His actions are far too self-righteous.」

stage0080_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Angels, Third Impact... and Evangelion.
　Being made to fight without knowing
　the truth is wearing thin, for $$シンジ$$ and for us.」

stage0080_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$n
「$$ミサト$$...
　what happened to $$アスカ$$?」

stage0080_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...The cellular erosion is gone, but we still
　can't rule out mental contamination by an Angel.」

stage0080_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We'll just have to keep her isolated for now.」

stage0080_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$赤木$$
「She'll get better, right!?
　Please, tell me she'll get better!」

stage0080_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...At this point, I can't say for sure...」

stage0080_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アスカ$$...
　And she was finally starting to open up...」

stage0080_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...If we'd tried harder,
　could we have saved $$アスカ$$...」

stage0080_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$シモン$$
「...It's about $$シンジ$$ and $$アスカ$$...」

stage0080_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Don't think my eyes are just for show, $$シモン$$.
　What's really on your mind is the EVA.」

stage0080_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「No... I'd say you're afraid of it!」

stage0080_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ギミー$$
「What's wrong!?
　I can't believe $$シモン$$ would be scared of anything!」

stage0080_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$キタン$$
「That ain't like you, $$シモン$$.
　Aren't you the guy who never flinches,
　no matter how big the enemy is?」

stage0080_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$シモン$$
「If it's an enemy, I just clash with it head-on.
　But that thing...」

stage0080_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$シモン$$
「I can't explain it, but that thing is dangerous...
　Something about it is fundamentally
　different from other machines.」

stage0080_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$隼人$$
「Something inside you is sounding the alarm...」

stage0080_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シモン$$
「If it's about machines that make no sense,
　Aquarion, $$ジェニオン$$, and Unicorn are
　all just as strange...」

stage0080_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シモン$$
「But the EVA... that Unit-01,
　something about it's different...」

stage0080_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ニア$$
（It's because you are the same kind of being.）

stage0080_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?」

stage0080_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$キタン$$
「Get a grip, $$シモン$$.
　I get that $$アスカ$$'s got you shaken up,
　but what good are you like this?」

stage0080_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「It's only natural that you'd be on edge.」

stage0080_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「$$アドヴェント$$...!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0080_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I came to warn you of danger.」

stage0080_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シモン$$
「Does that danger have something to do
　with what you just said about me being on edge?」

stage0080_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$シモン$$...
　When your head is held down, you draw out
　the strength to break through it...」

stage0080_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now that the whole world is being wrapped
　in the Prison of Time, that sense of confinement
　is instead awakening your power.」

stage0080_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's hurry.
　He may already be closing in.」

stage0080_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You're covering your ears again, like that?」

stage0080_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If I cover my ears, my heart closes off too.
　Then I don't have to touch this awful world.」

stage0080_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's right.
　A world with the dad I hate, scary Angels, EVAs,
　a world that makes me do awful things...」

stage0080_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「With a Dummy, it's a world dad doesn't
　need me in, a world where I hurt my friends too...」

stage0080_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But there were good things too.
　...In the end, though, it all breaks down.
　An awful world...」

stage0080_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「...Did you try to understand your father, Ikari?」

stage0080_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Didn't you do nothing at all?」

stage0080_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I did try to understand him!
　It's dad who's wrong!
　He's the one who abandoned me!」

stage0080_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Running away from what you hate again, like that?」

stage0080_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So what if I am!
　What's wrong with running from what I hate!?」

stage0080_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's fine...
　Just keep running like that, then...」

stage0080_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I see...
　So dad picked me up...」

stage0080_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Where are you going, $$シンジ$$?」

stage0080_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm not... getting in the EVA anymore...」

stage0080_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...Understood.
　I'll let everyone know myself.」

stage0080_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Right now, I can't stop you.」

stage0080_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Honestly...
　maybe even I don't really care
　about humanity or the world.」

stage0080_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I ended up in this position, but at first
　I just wanted to get a little closer to my
　dead father, so I volunteered for NERV.」

stage0080_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just like how you got in the EVA because
　you wanted Commander Ikari to need you...」

stage0080_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So I ended up overlapping my own feelings onto you.
　I know that's felt like a burden to you too.」

stage0080_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I know you've grown disappointed in
　your reasons for getting in the EVA now.
　But even so, I still...」

stage0080_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...That day, $$レイ#333$$ invited Commander Ikari too.
　She wanted you to get along with your father.
　She wanted you all to laugh together...」

stage0080_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't laugh with anyone anymore.
　$$アスカ$$, too... after what happened to her...」

stage0080_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Don't go deciding she's dead on your own.」

stage0080_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$アドヴェント$$...
　You... how did you get in here...?」

stage0080_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That doesn't matter right now.」

stage0080_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Even with the internal split, he's part
　of Chrono... Is that why...?）

stage0080_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$シンジ$$...
　When $$アスカ$$ wakes up and sees you like this,
　what do you think she'll say...」

stage0080_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And now, the time has come for you to leave
　your parents' nest. Get in the Evangelion
　for your own sake, not your father's.」

stage0080_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not something... I want to hear from you.」

stage0080_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If it's your own choice not to get in it,
　that's fine too.」

stage0080_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ミサト$$
「But, $$シンジ$$...
　if you refuse to pilot EVA just to
　spite your father or me, I won't forgive you」

stage0080_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Think back, $$シンジ$$.
　When you were fighting as $c,
　were you only fighting for your father?」

stage0080_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Wanting to save someone, to protect
　the world... Didn't you feel that,
　not even a little?」

stage0080_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Tell me, $$シンジ$$...
　Are you Commander Ikari's son,
　his Daddy's Boy?」

stage0080_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カヲル$$
（Fate has shifted, if only a little...）

stage0080_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カヲル$$
（This means the Tenth Angel won't
　appear again for a while...）

stage0080_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カヲル$$
「A bit of a shame...
　It seems my visit to see him
　will be delayed too」

stage0080_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「To think you'd turn yourself in」

stage0080_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We judged her unrelated to this matter,
　so she's standing by at $c」

stage0080_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「So her affiliation is $c now,
　not NERV...」

stage0080_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Insubordination, private use of an EVA,
　a clumsy threat... These are all crimes.
　...Do you have anything to say?」

stage0080_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I did it because I thought it was necessary」

stage0080_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That judgment is mine to make」

stage0080_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「And if you're wrong, what am I
　supposed to do?」

stage0080_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I am stripping you of your qualification
　as an EVA pilot」

stage0080_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「And if I said that, what would
　you do?」

stage0080_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Even without an EVA, I'll find
　something I can do」

stage0080_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Paying any price to fulfill your
　own wish, by your own strength...
　Is that your idea of becoming an adult?」

stage0080_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't want to become the kind of
　adult who steals someone's happiness
　or life to get there」

stage0080_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「This entire incident will be excused
　as a judgment call made in the field
　by the pilot」

stage0080_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The three EVAs will continue to operate
　under $c, as before.
　I leave command to you」

stage0080_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Will Unit-02 be operated by
　$$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$?」

stage0080_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That's right.
　She too is one of the children」

stage0080_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's fine.
　A delay of this scale was expected」

stage0080_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$冬月$$
「So you'll let things run their course...」

stage0080_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「And that's only for another month」

stage0080_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$冬月$$
「At the $$大統領$$s' meeting in Dakar, it was
　decided that on November 1st, the truth of
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ will be told to all mankind」

stage0080_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$冬月$$
「By then, the abnormality will be plain
　to anyone's eyes anyway」

stage0080_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then, we shall watch how things unfold.
　Until the time of evolution... the day
　of Instrumentality...」

stage0080_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シモン$$
「What a pathetic face.
　You're the guy who talked that big,
　aren't you」

stage0080_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シモン$$'s tough, isn't he」

stage0080_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ニア$$... There's someone
　waiting for me」

stage0080_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Same goes for you, $$シンジ$$.
　Everyone was waiting for you
　to come back」

stage0080_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$甲児$$
「If your old man had talked you into
　staying, we were all gonna go drag
　you back ourselves」

stage0080_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$n
「I believed $$シンジ$$ would come back
　on his own」

stage0080_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$葵$$
「Of course.
　$$シンジ$$'s a member of $c, after all」

stage0080_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$タケル$$
「Painful things, sad things, hard things,
　we've all gotten through them together」

stage0080_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Helping each other, being helped
　in turn」

stage0080_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Your hot soul, it hit me hard」

stage0080_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$桂$$
「Even that cranky old man was
　caught off guard」

stage0080_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's about time you flew the nest
　from your father's protection」

stage0080_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're a full-grown man now,
　$$シンジ$$」

stage0080_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're not the only ones who were
　waiting for $$シンジ$$」

stage0080_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$...?」

stage0080_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$キャシー$$
「After a quick round of greetings,
　she shut herself in her quarters」

stage0080_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So she has no intention of talking
　with us...」

stage0080_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$キャシー$$
「A file has arrived for Colonel
　Katsuragi. It's said to be information
　about her」

stage0080_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Goodbye, father...
　I don't know what I can do, but
　I'll go looking for it...）

stage0080_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$キタン$$
「You know the drill, $$ギミー$$, $$ダリー$$?」

stage0080_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Yes, let's back $$シモン$$ up together」

stage0080_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ギミー$$
「When the time comes for $$シモン$$ to
　win back $$ニア$$, we'll clear out
　anyone in the way」

stage0080_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$キタン$$
「Alright...!
　Don't you forget that fire!」

stage0080_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's sweet, $$キタン$$.
　Supporting $$シモン$$ from the shadows」

stage0080_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$キタン$$
「$$ニア$$ looked after my niece $$アンネ$$,
　after all... And more than that,
　that lady's Dai-Gurren Brigade too」

stage0080_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$キタン$$
「And besides, a guy busting his ass
　for the woman he loves, you can't help
　but root for him」

stage0080_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Hmm...
　Could it be you're in love with
　someone too, $$キタン$$?」

stage0080_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ギミー$$
（Go! Bore through with the drill
　of your heart!!）

stage0080_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Stoooooop!!
　At this rate, Master $$キタン$$ will
　generate too many Z-Chips and break!」

stage0080_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$キタン$$'s heart-throbs make
　100Z of Z-Chips a minute, but his heart
　will overheat in under five minutes!」

stage0080_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For now, I've added that first 100Z
　to the squad's stock, but any more
　would be dangerous!」

stage0080_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Your face is bright red, $$キタン$$.
　Shouldn't you go to the infirmary?」

stage0080_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「No need to push yourself.
　If our reckless captain $$キタン$$ goes down,
　the Dai-Gurren Brigade's in trouble too」

stage0080_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Come on, let's go.
　Want me to lend you a shoulder?」

stage0080_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Don't interrupt, $$ＡＧ$$!
　It was just getting good!」

stage0080_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ダリー$$
「It's fine, $$ギミー$$.
　At least $$キタン$$... seems to have
　made some progress」

stage0080_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Quite right.
　...And Master $$キタン$$ is a fine man.
　He'll set things right when the time comes」

stage0080_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm already looking forward to how
　many Z-Chips that'll produce」

stage0080_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To help Master $$キタン$$ and Master $$シモン$$
　do their best, I've stocked some
　special goods. Please take a look!」

stage0080_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$マリ$$
「Yo, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Looks like you're working hard」

stage0080_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, business as usual, I'd say.
　...So, Master $$マリ$$... what brings
　you here today?」

stage0080_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$マリ$$
「Haha, don't mind me.
　Just pretend I'm basically not here」

stage0080_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$マリ$$
「It's not that.
　It's just that this isn't my place,
　that's all」

stage0080_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$マリ$$
「So that's why this is the last time
　I show up here! I'll cut loose
　without holding back!」

stage0080_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood!
　This $$ＡＧ$$ will go all out too!」

stage0080_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's get fired up today too!!」

stage0080_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$マリ$$
「Business, business!
　And bye-bye while I'm at it!」
